messages:
maya: heads-up — canary run for raven-lite int4 showed a spike in funcall parse errors and a 40ms p50 latency bump vs baseline. sample size ~1k. forwarding logs.
liam: saw it, thanks. is the parse failure > schema mismatch or truncated JSON?
maya: mostly truncated suffixes. examples:
liam: ```{"action":"call","tool":"search","args": {"q":"pricing plan`  <-- cutoff
```
maya: also a few with extra trailing tokens like `]}` repeated. counts: 27 parse errors / 1000 (2.7%), baseline ~0.2%
infra-bot: Canary run 3456789012 finished — 1k requests, failures: 27, latency p50: 140ms (+40ms)
eva: can we link to raw traces?
maya: https://internal.redwood/ci/canary/3456789012
liam: quick debug idea: KV-cache prefixing may be truncating last chunk when batch split occurs. saw p99 batch size 16 bursts.
maya: good call — can we repro with mocked kvcache?
liam: I'll spin a small repro with kvprefix toggled off, ETA 30m
maya: also thinking about soft-repair: if parse fails, run a lightweight heuristic that strips trailing partial tokens and re-tries once before returning failure. maybe use a 200 token window.
liam: hmm prefer to preserve semantics — maybe attempt NDJSON wrapping: try to wrap with `[` + content + `]` and parse as array, then take last object if that parses.
eva: is this allowed by evals? could mask real regressions. product requires we flag repair usage in telemetry.
maya: agreed — add telemetry tag `parse_repair=ndjson_wrap` and incrementally enable on canary.
liam: infra-bot run suggestion: add a canary variant with `repair_strategy=ndjson_wrap` and `kvcache_prefix=false` and compare.
maya: patch saved to PR 789 — includes instrumentation + sample logging. requesting review @liam @eva
liam: reviewing now. quick nit: add counters for `repair_attempts` and `repaired_success`.
sre-bot: alert created: #inc-parse-spike-3456789012
maya: if repro shows kvcache is culprit we should push a kernel-level work item to ensure stream boundaries preserved across batch splits.
eva: keep me posted — if repaired_success > 90% we can rollout as fallback with metrics gating.
liam: will update in ~45m with repro numbers.
maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
